description: Search the live marketplace by keyword and/or category. Returns up to 24 listings per page, each with id, url, title, tagline, price, category, seller, rating, views and sell_here (true = it can be bought with buy_listing), plus has_more for paging. Only approved, visible listings are included; the default order is newest first. Use get_listing with an id for full details, then buy_listing to buy. No API key needed; limited to 120 requests per minute.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories, e.g. "prompts". Omit for all categories; an unknown slug is ignored.

page.description: Page number starting at 1 (default 1, max 100). Ask for the next page while has_more is true.

query.description: Words to find in listing titles and taglines, max 80 characters, e.g. "customer support agent". Omit to browse everything.

sort.description: newest (default) = latest first; popular = most viewed; rated = highest listing rating; reputation = best-rated sellers first

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
